phase_0.boundary_condition: the integer N as a closed divisor-boundary: every factor is a divisor in [2, N-1], and the boundary closes exactly when p·q = N.

⊢.chosen_element: the empty register before N is named

⊣.justification: terminal anchor — the closed boundary containing all divisors

≻.chosen_element: scale_ascent: a forward step of the winding leaper up the number line

≺.chosen_element: chiral_descent: the reverse that clears the open register

⋈.justification: composition — sequential chaining of the multiplication

⊙.chosen_element: the winding's internal model of its own orbit

∈.chosen_element: asymmetric_factorization: N forks into two unequal poles p and q
∈.justification: splits N into its two factors

∋.chosen_element: winding_reconstitution: the two poles rejoin by exact multiplication
∋.justification: reconstitutes p·q = N, matching the FSPLIT input

⊤.chosen_element: the divisor p frozen on the T-arm

⊥.chosen_element: the cofactor q held on the F-arm

⊞.chosen_element: both factors held at once — the B state of the semiprime
⊞.justification: a paradice: p and q held together without resolution until the latch

⊡.chosen_element: cluster_propagation: the single committed winding-commit at ⊡

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.true_description: 01 — a factor is constructively found (p | N)
phase_3.both_description: 11 — both factors held at once; the semiprime is B until the latch

steps.domain_action: the register is empty — N not yet named
ascend one step — the winding leaper takes its first jump
the winding records its own orbit (the self-model of the map)
∈ forks N into two unequal poles p and q — asymmetric_factorization
the T-arm freezes the divisor p
the carry chains the multiplication column by column
the F-arm holds the cofactor q
the chiral descent clears the open register (the count was banked in the frame)
hold both poles at once — the B state of the semiprime
∋ fuses the two poles back by exact multiplication
⊡ commits the factor — the cluster_propagation latch
the divisor-boundary closes; p·q = N exactly

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the ∈/∋ dyad compiling a split into fork/fuse
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the FSPLIT frames (banked counts survive AREV)
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the ROTAT orbit — the winding's period

phase_6.cycle_cost: one winding step per leaper jump
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the cycle is entropy-conservative: μ∘δ returns the split input exactly
